snippet.title: SPRKLS.exe Chapter 1 Playtest Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

SPRKLS.exe is a cute, melancholic visual novel that plays out on your own desktop, inside a haunted operating system called Mirrors OS that's full of ghosts and skeletons. You drag windows around, open files and solve puzzles to uncover its secrets. From indie studio PesiiDom.
